Islam Will Replace Collapsing Amerikan Empire wrote...
> Australia to "Brainwash" Jailed Extremists
> 
> SYDNEY, March 9, 2006 (IslamOnline.net & News Agencies) - The Australian 
> government announced on Thursday, March 9, it would consider a proposal by 
> its top policeman to "de-program" Muslims jailed on terror charges despite 
> criticism from rights activists branding the idea as a form of brainwashing.

I'm fascinated by brainwashing and it is just incredible how the pseudo-
science of psychology is so effective at controlling a person's mind.
But I also recognize that the only way to treat a brainwashing victim is
to re-brainwash him into a more normal mode, and the process is usually
called deprogramming and used to treat rescued cult members.

I'll generalize a bit, but typically rights activists are leftists and
leftists are often some of the biggest proponents of brainwashing those
whose behavior or speech offends them.  They avoid the term brainwashing
and usually refer to it as education, counseling, or rehabilitation,
but it is the same thing as brainwashing as the offending person is
re-programmed to conform to leftist standards of proper thinking and
behavior.

So I'm perplexed by the left's opposition to this proposal; leftists
usually oppose violence and happily accept forced treatment of prison
inmates, domestic violence offenders, drug users, etc. to cure them
of their anti-social tendencies, yet in this case they are defending
the most extremely anti-social and violent criminals on earth from
any attempt to re-program them into productive human beings.

---------------------------------------------------------------------
"When someone approves of the purpose for which propaganda is being
used in a given case, he generally calls it 'education' or applies to
it some similar euphemism.  But propaganda is propaganda regardless
of the purpose for which it is used."
